package router

import (
	"github.com/InfraFund-net7/backpro/internal/interfaces/rest"
	"github.com/InfraFund-net7/backpro/internal/interfaces/rest/handler"
	"github.com/InfraFund-net7/backpro/internal/interfaces/rest/middleware"
	"github.com/InfraFund-net7/backpro/pkg/crypto"
	"github.com/danielgtaylor/huma/v2"
	"github.com/ja7ad/captcha"
)

type Router struct {
	api  huma.API
	v1   *huma.Group
	rcap captcha.Captcha
	auth *middleware.AuthMiddleware
}

func NewRouter(srv *rest.Rest,
	aut *crypto.JWT,
	wh *handler.WaitlistHandler,
	cfh *handler.ContactFormHandler,
	ch *handler.LocationHandler,
	nrwh *handler.NonResidentWaitlistHandler,
	ah *handler.AuthHandler,
) {
	rut := &Router{
		api:  srv.API(),
		v1:   huma.NewGroup(srv.API(), "/v1"),
		rcap: srv.ReCaptcha(),
		auth: middleware.NewAuthMiddleware(srv.API(), aut),
	}

	rut.setupWaitList(wh)
	rut.setupLocation(ch)
	rut.setupContactForm(cfh)
	rut.setupNonResidentWaitlist(nrwh)
	rut.setupAuth(ah)
}

	"github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"

func (r *Router) setupNonResidentWaitlist(nrwh *handler.NonResidentWaitlistHandler) {
	nrw := huma.NewGroup(r.v1, "/non-resident-waitlist")

	huma.Register(nrw, huma.Operation{
		OperationID: "CreateNonResidentWaitlistIndividualForm",
		Summary:     "Create Non-Resident Waitlist Individual Form",
		Description: "Create a non-resident waitlist individual form.",
		Method:      fiber.MethodPost,
		Path:        "/individual",
		Tags:        []string{"Non-Registration Forms"},
		Errors:      []int{500, 409, 400},
		Middlewares: huma.Middlewares{middleware.Recaptcha(r.api, r.rcap)},
	}, nrwh.CreateIndividualForm)

	huma.Register(nrw, huma.Operation{
		OperationID: "CreateNonResidentWaitlistCompanyForm",
		Summary:     "Create Non-Resident Waitlist Company Form",
		Description: "Create a non-resident waitlist company form.",
		Method:      fiber.MethodPost,
		Path:        "/company",
		Tags:        []string{"Non-Registration Forms"},
		Errors:      []int{500, 409, 400},
		Middlewares: huma.Middlewares{middleware.Recaptcha(r.api, r.rcap)},
	}, nrwh.CreateCompanyForm)
}

- Integration tests for all API endpoints
- Error handling audit (consistent error responses)

- Environment variable documentation
- Verify existing database works with new backend (zero-downtime switchover)
